title: 12 Best Craft Beer Bars & Breweries in Buenos Aires — The Unfiltered Guide
description: The best craft beer bars and breweries in Buenos Aires — curated from Reddit reviews.

places.name: Strange Brewing

redditQuotes.text: The brewery that fearlessly competes in the world of hopped beers with any brewery from abroad. The quality is superlative and for me it’s the best brewery in Argentina.
redditQuotes.source: — r/BuenosAires · Craft Breweries in CABA thread, 2026

redditQuotes.text: This is the top craft beer spot in Buenos Aires. The massive tanks are in the back, a bar in the middle, and an outdoor patio space.
redditQuotes.source: — nickipoststravelstuff.com · Craft Beer Buenos Aires Guide, 2024

places.verdict: The undisputed #1 craft brewery in Buenos Aires — Reddit’s unanimous top pick for hop-forward beers.

comparison.best for: IPA and NEIPA specialists in Colegiales
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ from 6,273 Google reviews · Reddit’s #1 craft beer pick
comparison.limitations: Gets very crowded on weekends · Not cheap by local standards
comparison.why it made the list: Every Reddit thread about craft beer in Buenos Aires names Strange Brewing first. Their IPA and NEIPA game competes with top US breweries. Hipster-industrial brewpub with visible tanks and great food.
comparison.what to order: Start with their flagship NEIPA or any DDH variant. The nachos are legendary. The osso buco sandwich is a sleeper hit.

places.whatToOrder: Start with their flagship NEIPA or any DDH variant. The nachos are legendary. The osso buco sandwich is a sleeper hit.
places.insiderTip: Every Reddit thread about craft beer in Buenos Aires names Strange Brewing first. Their IPA and NEIPA game competes with top US breweries. Hipster-industrial brewpub with visible tanks and great food.

places.name: Desarmadero Bar

redditQuotes.text: By far the best beer bar in Palermo! It has one of the best beer lists, all the big names are there: Juguetes, Strange, Prinston, Sir Hopper, Astor, Minga.
redditQuotes.source: — r/BuenosAires · Craft Breweries in CABA thread, 2026

redditQuotes.text: Desarmadero has been a reference point for craft beer lovers since 2017 and is one of the most popular spots for both connoisseurs and the curious.
redditQuotes.source: — viewbuenosaires.com · Craft Beer in Buenos Aires, 2025

places.verdict: The best beer bar in Palermo — 41 taps featuring Argentina’s finest craft breweries plus hearty, unpretentious food.

comparison.best for: 41-tap beer bar curating the best Argentine craft brewers
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ from 19,367 reviews · 41 taps · Reddit’s best beer bar in Palermo
comparison.limitations: Extremely packed on weekends · Can be loud
comparison.why it made the list: With 41 taps from every top Argentine brewer — Strange, Juguetes Perdidos, Prinston, Sir Hopper — Desarmadero is the best place to sample BA’s beer breadth. Food standout: goulash, sweetbreads, flank steak.
comparison.what to order: Ask for the current IPA rotation. The goulash is the ‘secret bomb.’ Flank steak pizzaiola and sweetbreads are excellent.

places.whatToOrder: Ask for the current IPA rotation. The goulash is the ‘secret bomb.’ Flank steak pizzaiola and sweetbreads are excellent.
places.insiderTip: With 41 taps from every top Argentine brewer — Strange, Juguetes Perdidos, Prinston, Sir Hopper — Desarmadero is the best place to sample BA’s beer breadth. Food standout: goulash, sweetbreads, flank steak.

places.name: On Tap Palermo

redditQuotes.text: With 20 Argentinian craft beers on tap, On Tap is for sure one of my top places in Buenos Aires to drink craft beer. Highly recommended.
redditQuotes.source: — christravelblog.com · Buenos Aires Craft Beer Bars, 2024

places.verdict: A curated Palermo tap room with 20+ Argentine craft beers on draft.

comparison.best for: 20+ rotating Argentine craft taps in Palermo Hollywood
comparison.strengths: 4.2★ from 2,624 reviews · 20+ taps · Multiple city locations
comparison.limitations: Closed Mon/Sun · Opens evening only on weekdays
comparison.why it made the list: On Tap focuses on pure beer with 20+ Argentine craft beers on draft. The Palermo Hollywood branch is the flagship with relaxed atmosphere and knowledgeable staff.
comparison.what to order: Ask for the current NEIPA or pale ale. The flight option lets you sample 4-5 beers at once.

places.whatToOrder: Ask for the current NEIPA or pale ale. The flight option lets you sample 4-5 beers at once.
places.insiderTip: On Tap focuses on pure beer with 20+ Argentine craft beers on draft. The Palermo Hollywood branch is the flagship with relaxed atmosphere and knowledgeable staff.

places.name: Growlers Palermo

redditQuotes.text: Growlers has become one of the best breweries in Buenos Aires. Each branch exudes a youthful spirit with incredible murals.
redditQuotes.source: — viewbuenosaires.com · Craft Beer in Buenos Aires, 2025

places.verdict: The craft beer chain done right — 7 locations with solid IPAs, rotating taps, and growler fills.

comparison.best for: Reliable craft beer with 7 locations across BA
comparison.strengths: 4.4★ from 10,544 reviews · 7 city locations · Growler fills
comparison.limitations: Chain feel · Less unique than independent brewpubs
comparison.why it made the list: With 7 locations, Growlers is the most accessible craft beer in BA. Quality is genuinely good. Fill a growler to take home.
comparison.what to order: House IPA is solid. Try rotating NEIPA seasonal. Fill a growler for your hotel. Burgers are reliable.

places.whatToOrder: House IPA is solid. Try rotating NEIPA seasonal. Fill a growler for your hotel. Burgers are reliable.
places.insiderTip: With 7 locations, Growlers is the most accessible craft beer in BA. Quality is genuinely good. Fill a growler to take home.

places.name: Buller Brewing

redditQuotes.text: Buller is one of the first craft beer places in Buenos Aires and a solid spot in Recoleta.

places.verdict: Buenos Aires’ OG craft brewery — the pioneer that kicked off the city’s beer revolution, right by Recoleta Cemetery.

comparison.best for: Pioneer craft brewery in upscale Recoleta
comparison.strengths: 4.2★ from 15,672 reviews · BA craft beer pioneer · Recoleta location
comparison.limitations: More touristy · Beer quality has plateaued say some locals
comparison.why it made the list: Buller started BA’s craft beer revolution. Most well-known name among tourists. Near Recoleta Cemetery, reliable beer, open until 3 AM on weekends.
comparison.what to order: Honey beer is their signature. Order a tasting flight of 5. Pair with wood-fired pizza.

places.whatToOrder: Honey beer is their signature. Order a tasting flight of 5. Pair with wood-fired pizza.
places.insiderTip: Buller started BA’s craft beer revolution. Most well-known name among tourists. Near Recoleta Cemetery, reliable beer, open until 3 AM on weekends.

places.name: Rabieta en La Paris
places.address: Av. del Libertador 3949, Palermo, Buenos Aires

redditQuotes.text: Rabieta en La Paris is a top Buenos Aires craft brewery for its wide variety and beautiful Palermo setting.

places.verdict: A major Argentine craft beer brand with a beautiful Palermo brewpub and consistently solid beer.

comparison.best for: Large-scale Argentine craft brewery with scenic Palermo taproom
comparison.strengths: 4.2★ from 12,837 reviews · Beautiful venue · Wide beer range
comparison.why it made the list: Rabieta is one of Argentina’s biggest craft brands, but their Palermo taproom (La Paris) is genuinely worth visiting. Gorgeous converted building with high ceilings and outdoor terrace.
comparison.what to order: The Rabieta IPA is their bestseller. Seasonal specials are often excellent.

places.whatToOrder: The Rabieta IPA is their bestseller. Seasonal specials are often excellent.
places.insiderTip: Rabieta is one of Argentina’s biggest craft brands, but their Palermo taproom (La Paris) is genuinely worth visiting. Gorgeous converted building with high ceilings and outdoor terrace.

places.name: Cervecería The Prancing Pony

redditQuotes.text: My little haunt that gives me so much love. Nerdy themed with Lord of the Rings — helmets, flags, models and even a dragon on the ceiling.
redditQuotes.source: — r/BuenosAires · Craft Breweries in CABA thread, 2026

places.verdict: A Lord of the Rings-themed craft beer bar in Boedo — cheap pints, nerdy vibes, and a dragon on the ceiling.

comparison.best for: Budget LOTR-themed craft beer bar in Boedo
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ from 1,955 reviews · Cheapest craft beer · Unique LOTR theme
comparison.limitations: Beer quality a step below top picks · Off the tourist trail · Basic food
comparison.why it made the list: Hidden in Boedo, this LOTR-themed bar has helmets, flags, models, and a dragon on the ceiling. Cheapest craft beer in BA. Where nerds and locals hang.
comparison.what to order: Whatever IPA is on tap — prices so low you can try multiple. The cheese and potato platter is legendary comfort food.

places.whatToOrder: Whatever IPA is on tap — prices so low you can try multiple. The cheese and potato platter is legendary comfort food.
places.insiderTip: Hidden in Boedo, this LOTR-themed bar has helmets, flags, models, and a dragon on the ceiling. Cheapest craft beer in BA. Where nerds and locals hang.

places.name: Geppetto Bar

redditQuotes.text: Very good beer list — Juguetes, Itzel, Strange. Let’s say it’s the younger sibling of El Desarmadero.
redditQuotes.source: — r/BuenosAires · Craft Breweries in CABA thread, 2026

places.verdict: Devoto’s answer to Desarmadero — excellent tap list with Juguetes, Strange, and Itzel.

comparison.best for: Quality craft beer bar in residential Devoto
comparison.strengths: 4.5★ from 2,991 reviews · Great tap list · Neighborhood gem
comparison.limitations: Far west of tourist center · Smaller venue
comparison.why it made the list: Reddit calls it ‘the younger sibling of Desarmadero’ — same caliber tap list (Juguetes Perdidos, Itzel, Strange) in a quieter neighborhood.
comparison.what to order: Ask for Juguetes Perdidos or Itzel on tap. Burgers, picadas, and empanadas are reliable.

places.whatToOrder: Ask for Juguetes Perdidos or Itzel on tap. Burgers, picadas, and empanadas are reliable.
places.insiderTip: Reddit calls it ‘the younger sibling of Desarmadero’ — same caliber tap list (Juguetes Perdidos, Itzel, Strange) in a quieter neighborhood.

places.name: El Galpón de Tacuara

redditQuotes.text: El Galpón de Tacuara’s craft beers are distinguished by Belgian malt and North American hops. Their dedication has garnered important international awards.
redditQuotes.source: — viewbuenosaires.com · Craft Beer in Buenos Aires, 2025

places.verdict: Award-winning brewery using Belgian malt and American hops — 5 locations across Buenos Aires.

comparison.best for: Award-winning house-brewed craft beer with 5 locations
comparison.strengths: 4.5★ from 7,944 reviews · International awards · Belgian malt + American hops
comparison.limitations: Chain feel · Original in San Fernando is far from center
comparison.why it made the list: They brew everything themselves using Belgian malt and North American hops. Won international competitions. Sanfer IPA and Jim Morrison are standouts.
comparison.what to order: Sanfer IPA is the flagship. Jim Morrison combines roasted malts with bourbon. Irish Red Ale for lighter drinkers.

places.whatToOrder: Sanfer IPA is the flagship. Jim Morrison combines roasted malts with bourbon. Irish Red Ale for lighter drinkers.
places.insiderTip: They brew everything themselves using Belgian malt and North American hops. Won international competitions. Sanfer IPA and Jim Morrison are standouts.

places.name: Bierlife

redditQuotes.text: Bierlife is among the best craft beer spots in Buenos Aires, in the heart of San Telmo.

places.verdict: San Telmo’s go-to craft beer bar — extensive taps in BA’s most characterful neighborhood.

comparison.best for: Craft beer in the heart of San Telmo
comparison.strengths: 4.4★ from 8,116 reviews · San Telmo location · Large selection
comparison.why it made the list: San Telmo’s craft beer anchor. After the Sunday market, this is where you end up. Extensive tap list, fair prices, bohemian energy.
comparison.what to order: Ask for the rotating IPA selection. They carry beers from smaller producers.

places.whatToOrder: Ask for the rotating IPA selection. They carry beers from smaller producers.
places.insiderTip: San Telmo’s craft beer anchor. After the Sunday market, this is where you end up. Extensive tap list, fair prices, bohemian energy.

places.name: Antares Mercado San Telmo
places.address: Carlos Calvo 485, San Telmo, Buenos Aires

redditQuotes.text: Antares Mercado San Telmo is a top spot for craft beer inside one of Buenos Aires’ most famous markets.
redditQuotes.source: — Yelp · Top Beer Bars in Buenos Aires, 2026

places.verdict: Argentina’s biggest craft beer brand inside the iconic Mercado de San Telmo.

comparison.best for: Craft beer inside BA’s iconic San Telmo market
comparison.strengths: 4.2★ from 11,669 reviews · Inside Mercado San Telmo · Reliable quality
comparison.why it made the list: Argentina’s largest craft brand. San Telmo location inside the Mercado is interesting — grab beer while browsing food stalls and antiques.
comparison.what to order: Scotch Ale is their signature. Imperial Stout for cooler weather. Honey Beer for something lighter.

places.whatToOrder: Scotch Ale is their signature. Imperial Stout for cooler weather. Honey Beer for something lighter.
places.insiderTip: Argentina’s largest craft brand. San Telmo location inside the Mercado is interesting — grab beer while browsing food stalls and antiques.

places.name: Almagro Beer Co
places.address: Av. Díaz Vélez 3984, Almagro, Buenos Aires

redditQuotes.text: Off the beaten craft beer path. Small one-room spot with plenty of options on tap and fridges of cans for takeaway.
redditQuotes.source: — nickipoststravelstuff.com · Craft Beer Buenos Aires Guide, 2024

places.verdict: A one-room neighborhood taproom in residential Almagro — off every tourist radar.

comparison.best for: Ultra-local hidden gem taproom in Almagro
comparison.strengths: Off the tourist trail · Rotating taps · Growler fills
comparison.limitations: Tiny venue · Closes early at 10 PM · No food
comparison.why it made the list: Tiny one-room taproom in Almagro. One counter, a few stools, fridges of craft cans for takeaway. As local as it gets.
comparison.what to order: Whatever’s on tap. Grab cans from the fridge. Growler fills are the best value.
